6662-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6662-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a 2/2 green Bird creature token with its own landfall ability
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

687-2034-3530-4613-8130.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three additional counters of any kind on Tayam and/or additional creatures you control.
687-2034-3530-4613-8130.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grim Initiate, adding {C}{C}.
When Grim Initiate dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate [[Tayam]] by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, milling three cards and returning Grim Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability again, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter and a -0/-1 counter from the creature token and a vigilance counter from Grim Initiate.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Grim Initiate and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Grim Initiate dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three cards and returning Grim Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-2034-3530-4613-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {1} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

654-1308-3129-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2557-3129-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

6798-7084-7889.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2585-4574-4659-6769-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
2585-4574-4659-6769-6842.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Grim Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Grim Monolith from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Grim Monolith.
Repeat.

2034-3755-6970-7297-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

489-1621-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5957-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2169-2511--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2226-7070.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
2226-7070.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Zacama's first ability by paying {2}{R}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Zacama.
Zacama's ability from step 2 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Zacama from exile by paying {2}.
When Zacama enters, it triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.

1402-2218-4763-7296.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5657-5664-6657.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Writhing Chrysalis and Ulalek trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Writhing Chrysalis's trigger, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of at least two Writhing Chrysalis spells, at least two Writhing Chrysalis's triggers, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve a Writhing Chrysalis trigger, creating two Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from 5 any number of times.
Once you have infinite copies of the spells and triggers, you can resolve them all, activate any number of Eldrazi Spawn tokens, and trigger all Writhing Chrysalis's final abilities.
5657-5664-6657.notes: You may also perform this combo with {C}{C} less starting mana, skipping step 5. This does not result in infinite colorless mana or infinite creature tokens.

2366-3688-5702-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-5702-6791.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

273-2510-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
273-2510-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

4508-5880-6705-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Frog creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

729-874-1170-1329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
729-874-1170-1329.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1492-2854-4574-6918.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1492-2854-4574-6918.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2854-4574-6918.description:
Cast Welding Jar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4826-5414-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4826-5414-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

1497-3327-4613-6258.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-6258.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

488-1492-2895-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Tormod's Crypt or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1492-2895-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

877-1374-5910-6231.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Thunderclap Drake and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

2440-3562-4183-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sky Hussar
2440-3562-4183-4758.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
When the token Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sky Hussar, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sky Hussar for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

913-2440-2534-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter
913-2440-2534-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Coercive Recruiter for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6178.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6178.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Zektar Shrine Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Zektar Shrine Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

80-2784-2806-3019-3152.notablePrerequisites:
Inspiring Refrain in exile with three time counters on it.
Venture Forth in exile with two time counters on it.
Reality Strobe in exile with one time counter on it.
Alaundo the Seer does not have summoning sickness.
80-2784-2806-3019-3152.description:
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each other card you own in exile.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Reality Strobe, returning a permanent to its owner's hand, then exiling Reality Strobe with three time counters on it.
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each other card you own in exile.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Venture Forth, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a land card, then putting the land card onto the battlefield and the rest of the cards exiled this way on the bottom of your library, and then exiling Venture Forth with three time counters on it.
Activate Alaundo the Seer by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and exile a card from your hand with time counters on it equal to its mana value, then removing a time counter from each card you own in exile.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Alaundo the Seer.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and then exiling Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Repeat.

641-3765.manaNeeded: {6}{B}{R}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
641-3765.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Cast Kroxa from the command zone by paying {B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Kroxa enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve Kroxa's second ability, causing each opponent to lose three life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3062-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3062-3693.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1278-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
1278-4222-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping it and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat.

413-1778-2626-4986.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Memnite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

3075-3368-4036.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one experience counter.
Note: the starting mana prerequisite is reduced if you start with additional experience counters.
3075-3368-4036.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R}.
If you have fewer than three experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying at most {2}{R}{R}.
If you have fewer than three experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Resolve Reiterate, creating a copy of Seething Song and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

3525-3756-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
3525-3756-4644.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
